notes.title: Early Access!!!
notes.content:
The game is live and here's an update!

Core Gameplay:
[olist]
 There has been updates to the boats density when the boat is at a specific depth in the water.
 When the boat is at this depth, it will stay at that depth and no longer floats to the surface.
 This is also the same depth that triggers the headlights to turn on.
 9s Boost is now pink. Red is used more for hazards and direction banners.
 Added red track buoys to help show the track width. Also they float!
 More work has been done to race time calculations. Still more to come.
 The beginnings of the GP point system are working now. This is how to calculate what place the player starts in against the AI. More to come.
 Both Melancholy City and Sunny Valley Coast track designs have changed.
[/olist]

Visuals:
[olist]
 Checkpoint corners now blink to help them stand out more.
 Updates to underwater visuals like water clarity in lakes and ponds.
 Water performance update.
[/olist]

Bugs:
[olist]
 Fixed invisible collision bug most notably on Open Ocean. This clears up the issue on all maps.
 Fixed a buoyancy/water density bug with diving and rising. You can now dive and rise at the same velocity.
[/olist]

Side Notes:
[olist]
 Audio bug updates where some sounds couldn't be heard or would cut out.
 Regions still need to be updated so some text may not be translated.
[/olist]


Dev Comments:

 Feel free to join us in Discord!


Fresh Bread Games

notes.title: New Name, Bug Fixes, Visual Updates and New Content
notes.content:
Thanks for being patent between releases. I have been very busy welcoming a new member into my family! With the new little one around, things have been hectic! That said, it's been 4 months so here's a new update. Also... all of the legal stuff has been ironed out and I can finally announce the new name "Jet Rush"! Thank you again for being patent!

Core Gameplay:

 Boost item count has been drastically lowered. They are now permanent in the world and are set to respawn after 1 second.
 Boat top speed (without using boost) has been lowered slightly.
 More work has been done to race time calculations.
 All water zones have been expanded on. It should seem more natural in the way water behaves.
[olist]
 A small area like a bay will not have crashing waves.
 Area's more exposed to the ocean will now have larger crashing waves.
[/olist]
 Added "Wrong Way" and "Too Far From Track" notifications. This new system is new and will need a bit more tweaking. At any rate, these notifications can be toggled off in settings.
 Race opening screen has been expanded on.
[olist]
 This screen will now show images of all the maps in the GP and what map you're about to play.
 It will also show your previous race times for the tracks that have been played that round.
[/olist]
 Spikes and Mines now steal all boost and take a boat life. After the boat hits 3 of either. The boat is destroyed and the race ends. More to come.
 Boat Life Items have been added. Once they are collected, all three lives are given back.
 Numerous maps have been updated. Most notably the name for Mirror Lake 1 is now Mirror Pond and Mirror Lake 2 is now Mirror Lake. This will keep happening until all maps are just the way we like them!
 AI boats! They only exist in GP mode. They are pretty simple for now but work well enough. More to come.


Visuals:

 Underwater checkpoint visibility has been improved. In general, most objects are easier to spot underwater now.
 Added water surface floating checkers to Starting and Finish lines. I'm only mentioning this because it looks neat.
 Firework size and performance has been greatly improved.
 Weather types like "Foggy" and "Thunderstorm" are less taxing on the GPU.
 Added wings to every boat to better convey the real world physics that boat is experiencing. They do not apply drag or lift in or out of water. Purely cosmetic. More to come.


Side Notes:

 The way levels are literally loaded have been coded differently and improved. Loading screens no longer totally freeze and then studder the moment the level loads.
 Audio SFX have been expanded on.
 Regions still need to be updated so some text may not be translated.
 Began integrating Steam Online systems. Things like the players gamer tag and image are now visible.


Dev Comments:

 Feel free to join us in Discord!


Fresh Bread Games

notes.title: Updates Related To The Last Release
notes.content:
This update is directly related to the last release.

Major Changes:

 All Boost Buoys have been removed and are replaced by a boost tank that the player can fill as they play. The boost tank can be filled by gathering boost items. The Blue Boost will grant 3 seconds of boost and the Red Boost will grant 9 seconds. The tank can hold a total of 16 seconds.
 The overall top speed of the boat has been lowered but with boost, anything is possible!
 Jump is back! It requires you to have boost in the tank and has a 3 second cooldown.


Core Gameplay:

 Boat functionality above and below water has been updated. The boat can now move more freely.
 While underwater, the boat will pitch up or down based on the general velocity and trajectory it's currently moving in. This lets you dive and rise MUCH faster. You can almost touch the clouds!
 Sprint Mode has been removed for now. More to come.
 The checkpoint visual appearance has been updated again. They are no longer made of particles but are instead solid objects. This helps clean up the overall clutter on screen.
 Spike hazards now remove boost and are shrouded in fog.
 More work has been done to race time capturing. More to come.
 GP races now show the progress of where you are in the GP and bring you to a congratulations level when the GP is completed.
 Level section menus have been overhauled. Cups and their respective levels are now on one screen. They show a small screenshot.


Visuals:

 We have added another UI to show if you have passed or failed the required times for Gold, Silver and Bronze. After pressing continue, the final race results are shown.
 Race Details in the Race Results have been disabled for now. More to come.
 Water spray visuals have been improved to help convey the boat velocity.
 Firework size and performance has been drastically improved.
 Updated many models to be more detailed yet more performant.


Side Notes:

 Overall performance has been improved with foliage, particle effects and water.
 Regions still need to be updated so some text may not be translated.
 There has been improvements made to controller capturing for menus.


Dev Comments:

 If you have time, please join the Discord and let us know what you see!
 When you take screenshots and videos, try and have the FPS in the corner.


Fresh Bread Games

notes.title: Maps, Performance, Modes and More!
notes.content:
This is a big update for me and I can't wait for everyone to test it!

Core Gameplay:

 More races and modes! Since there's a lot more moving parts, achievements have been disabled temporarily. Currently there are a few easy achievements to get from the main menu but there are no achievements for completing the GP's and finding the bread. More to come.
 After getting some feedback, checkpoints are now easier to see! The first idea was to make it more of a challenge to try to hit the checkpoints but that just wasn't fun. Now there's a particle effect that wraps the edges of the checkpoint to help define their shape. (This was done to help visibility when underwater)
 Sprint Mode is now "functional" but VERY far from finished. In this mode we will introduce the doomsday timer. It's max time is set to 5 seconds. In order to reset the time, you will need to hit a Sprint Checkpoint Ring. If the timer hit's zero, the race ends and you fail. (These records and race times are not saved under their own category for now but eventually will be)
 Added a map called "Jet Sprint". This map is a representation of real life Jet Sprint boat racing! This type of racing is the core inspiration for Undertow. It's pretty tough and can get frustrating at times but worth it when you cross that finish line!
 Added the first map to have massive flooding simulated water! Canyon Rapids. There is still a lot of work to do here but I'm excited for it's future.


Visuals:

 The race result screen after the race got a rework and have been simplified. If you want to see the actual time between checkpoints, there is a button called "Race Details".
 Jet flames from the thrusters got a makeover. This is in preparation for letting players customize the colors of the jet itself. More to come.
 Water spray based on movement has been improved. Helps indicate the velocity and direction the boat is moving.
 More updates to overall surface water and underwater. First approach was to be fairly accurate to real life but that proved... not as much fun. Surface water detail has been simplified to better match the overall style of the game.
 Updated many actors to have more detail and fit better with the overall style of the game.


Fun Stuff:

 Added fireworks to the Starting Line and Finish Line. Also added small firework launchers throughout the levels. They launch fireworks when you only have 1 lap left, get moving!
 These fireworks are a bit of a resource hog but will be fixed in the next update.


Small Notes:

 Overall performance has been improved with foliage, particle effects and water.
 Regions still need to be updated so some text may not be translated.
 The music is still not finished but getting close. More to come.
 When early access goes live, the music will exist solely in the game for about 1 month before dropping on all major music platforms.


Dev Comments:

 If you have time, please join the Discord and let us know what you see!
 When you take screenshots and videos, try and have the FPS in the corner.

notes.title: Performance Updates and New Water Systems
notes.content:
Mini-map and Compass
Mini-map displays only relevant information like: Boost Buoys, Ramps, Checkpoints, Water Bombs, Spike Balls, Boat Cannons and the Track Path.

Water and Weather
 All water systems have been overhauled to be more in line with the type of physics we are trying to achieve. It's a big update that now includes coastal waves and large ocean waves with greater accuracy!
To help give each map a more personal and unique look, all maps (but Main Menu and Ocean Park) no longer have player controlled weather systems. They instead are hard set.
All of these water changes are helping us gear up for the new river systems!

Boat Updates
I know it's drastic but... you can no longer jump. We felt this adds a neat skill requirement. If you want to get height out of the water, you have to dive down and pull up!
Buoyancy and thrust have been overhauled to work with the new water.
Added new unlockable boats to choose from.
Each boat now has custom collision. Currently this added collision does not impact the boats mass, density and buoyancy. 

Performance
Foliage performance has been greatly improved across the board.
Swamps and Jungle biomes benefitted the most from this.
Temporarily disabled interactive fish.
New experimental shader system has been removed.
Almost all audio systems have been upgraded to the MetaSounds built into UE5.

Overall Game Updates
Removed the requirement of completing The Pond before you can do any form of racing.
Cups A and B are getting close to being completed.

Steam Deck Support
Numerous improvements have been implemented for a less demanding experience.
We are trying to get Undertow to run on many systems. In doing so, using the Low settings is more for mobile.
For Steam Deck only, currently it runs well on low setting with Lumen disabled. There is a known bug where the FPS seems to be capped at 40 but by no means does this impact anything.

New UI Languages
Spanish, Japanese and Chinese
This does not include The Pond.
If you spot something that doesn't make sense, please feel free to join our discord and let us know! Any help is greatly appreciated! As it is... I'm not even great at english!

Roadmap
Individual performance of boats. Like turning quicker and having faster acceleration at the cost of a higher top speed.
AI boats to race against.
Ghost replays of your best times to race against.
Hazzard maps. More to come on this.

From all of us at Fresh Bread Games, see you at the races! <3

notes.title: Checkpoint system, water and game size updates
notes.content:
New checkpoint system. This adds a massive quality of life to the way tracks are designed. All systems that are found along the track are attached to the track. This results in a much cleaner, accurate and consistent race. This also allows us to create prototypes much quicker.
The moving pyramid hazard now has 8 different patterns that are sure to screw up your race ;)
Boat performance has been tweaked. The boat no longer rotates and twitches. 
Checkpoints have been widened in 95% of all maps to allow the player to have more freedom when determining their race line.
Furthering the effort to improve performance on slower machines including the Steam Deck, all maps have more performant landscapes. The result is no change in visuals but a MASSIVE drop in file sizes. Faster loading too.
80% of all textures and shaders have been converted to Virtual Textures. This will help with devices that don't have a lot of VRAM. This also helps with general performance.
Sea creatures! Yes - finally, sharks, dolphins, whales and MANY more!
UI improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43415072/dd7d4e54438fa353e47cbe361716ab168d210794.png

notes.title: Small-Big Update
notes.content:
Boost Buoys are working again.


Lots of performance improvements with general settings and foliage. General settings have been simplified to offer a more generic experience. I want the game to run well on multi platforms instead of seeing more foliage on PC with super bad@$$ hardware... everyone will see the same thing regardless of the hardware.


Seriously I can't stress the increase in foliage performance so much so, I wanted to reiterate it.


Virtual memory consumption. At this point I have lowered the requirement for VRAM. It's shouldn't complain or run poorly if you have a max of 2gbs vram (more to come)


On that note, Raytracing is fully disabled. Now only supporting Lumen subsystems for lighting.


Shadows have been modified to perform well and look good. No more settings, just on or off.


VSync is disabled. MOAR FRAMES! Known issue: you may or may be able to turn quicker with more frames. Fix is coming soon.


New logic for AI boats. They are still very... derpy but work. You may be able spot one in a map!


Started to work on Steam Deck support. Right now, it's not running well but should still "run". Choosing the lowest texture setting with a render of 50-75% is advised when trying it on the Steam Deck. More to come.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43415072/dd7d4e54438fa353e47cbe361716ab168d210794.png

notes.title: Water, movement and physics OVERHAUL!
notes.content:
Completely reworked the thrust systems. They are now working the way I always wish they did LOL
High and low FPS still needs more testing. 60fps is the sweet spot for now.


Buoyancy truly considers the volume of the boat, how deep it is etc.


Water solution is brand new and very accurate. Next is working on the visual side of it.


KNOW ISSUES: Currently the boost buoys do nothing right now. At this point any boat will perform as if it had full boost. Will be updated next patch.


Foliage is more performant on all maps.


Fluid dynamics are working (the way they should) and are no longer bound by height. Next is making it look better and look into adding water spray visuals.


Stay tuned for more updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43415072/dd7d4e54438fa353e47cbe361716ab168d210794.png

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Bug fix for ultra wide screens. UI should reach the sides of the screen.


Turning systems take into account world delta time to avoid the turning be driven by frame.


Foliage overhaul.


Boost Buoy model change.


Checkpoint style update.


Spottle Isle 1, Zippy Swamps 1 and 2, Mirror Lake 1 and 2 all now have speed boosts.

notes.title: Lots of updates!
notes.content:
A good way to tell if a map isn't near completion is if it starts with a pink boost buoy. This usually means it doesn't have the normal boost buoys that only provide one speed star.


Fluid dynamics! Ooo pretty water.


The general hover-boat behavior is almost where we want it. At this point it's very responsive and feels like a "boat" that's slightly hovering. Currently it may be a bit too responsive which is more noticed at slow speeds. When moving very quickly, the responsiveness is appreciated lol


Many UI improvements. Font has been nearly finalized and is licensed through google. Controller support for the menu has improved


Music is finally in the works! Currently working closely with different artists.


Buoyancy! It's very hard to come up with what the water would feel like in a vehicle like this. Right now the buoyancy ramps up the closer you are to the surface. The deeper you are, the more the hover-boat wants to stay down.


Models. MANY model updates like ramps and buoys to be in line with the art style we want to achieve.


Checkpoints are more visible. Flying and Diving checkpoints and guide arrows signify that the player will need to jump or dive to get them.


Now that a lot of general game logic and performance is getting near what we want to see, we are getting back into the maps. This includes general level, biomes and course design.



MANY more updates to come!
